newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs dlr, firms vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs dlr, firms vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint retreated to its opening level against the dollar after an intra-day strengthening but firmed against the central bank's currency basket.

The forint closed at 185.80/85 to the dollar, compared to 185.82/87 at opening. By the end of play the forint closed the four-pip gap that separated it from the central bank's resistance level at opening.
Robert Szucs of Inter-Europa Bank said activity was somewhat above average as the domestic market followed hectic movements in dollar/mark crosses.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
